title: SCHC rekey reset is unauthenticated non-atomic and leaves stale senders usable
description: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py reset_fragmentation_for_rekey accepts only the old key, clears manager/replay separately, and does not invalidate existing FragmentSender capabilities. Tie reset to atomic old-to-new key installation, cancel old leases, block old-key RX, and test stale sender plus receive/reset interleavings.
notes: Post-fix review: reset is now old-to-new and manager/replay atomic, but concurrent handle_ack_frame/timeout can release the security lock after accept/touch, then rotation invalidates records, then return an old-key retransmission. Rotation must serialize with the full sender transition and invalidate status/capability before any output escapes.
